verdict.rationale: Render explicitly advertises Blueprint (render.yaml) support to "define, deploy, and version your entire architecture with a single YAML file," backed by ephemeral preview environments and rollback features that align with a versioned, single-config-file deploy workflow. Community evidence corroborates a docker-compose-like infrastructure-as-code experience, though it's more anecdotal than a deep technical walkthrough. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the YAML blueprint specifically (vs general IaC sentiment), and more detail on versioning/rollback tied directly to the config file.
